STAGE A IS THE PRIORITY AND MUST BE COMPLETE AND WRITTEN BEFORE STAGE B BEGINS. If the budget runs out, a finished Stage A with no Stage B is a SUCCESSFUL batch. Do not start Stage B until stage_a_results.json exists on disk.

STAGE A. Emit (x, y) for the 9 replicate instances of BATCH-f75059 (one re-run of the existing script) and repeat RT-20260803-dc7568's ROW-PERMUTATION NULL on each. The surrogate must preserve the exact multiset of x, the exact multiset of y, and every column marginal, removing ONLY which y pairs with which x. Report per instance and pooled: near-miss sd ratio, and correct minus best-of-8-near-miss, each real vs permuted with mean +/- sd. The batch-2 single-instance values to REPRODUCE OR REFUTE are 0.142888 vs 0.105408 +/- 0.000991 (+35.6%) and 0.001522 vs 0.001761 +/- 0.000011 (-13.6%).

STAGE A ALSO: repeat the 1/sqrt(N) decay control per instance. Batch 2's single-instance excess was 1.062/0.987/1.193/1.354 at N' = 500/2000/8000/17919, claimed non-decaying while the surrogate decays. A separation that decays like its surrogate across 9 instances is DEAD and you must say so plainly.

STAGE B. Adopt the successor design from wellposedness.md section 6: k_lat = 15, k_fft = 10, p in {2,3,5}, beta_sieve = 50. State the resulting Nf tuple explicitly and confirm it is admissible against the line-540 identity. This design turns exp(k_fft/3 (sigma_s pi / p)^2) ON -- it is identically 1 in the batch-2 design and equals 2685.7 = 2^11.39 at the pinned estimator's own ML-KEM-512 optimum. Report the term's value here.

NULL SUFFICIENCY (DEC-20260803-264d6a PD-2). For EVERY null you run, state three things in the artifact: the OBJECT removed, the STATISTIC used, and a SENSITIVITY DEMONSTRATION for that pair -- a case where the statistic provably changes when the object does. Naming the object is necessary and NOT sufficient: batch 2's NULL-V named four objects and used a statistic that could not read three of them.
Report per candidate GROUP -- uniform, secret-distribution, near-miss -- and NEVER pooled across them. Every quantity carries mean +/- sd over >=1000 draws.

BOTH OUTCOMES ARE PUBLISHABLE AND NEITHER IS EXPECTED. If Stage A kills the separation, say so plainly -- that is the single most valuable result available to this batch. If it replicates, it is still one design at toy scale.
